page.layout: One page of text: a running head at the top, then a chronological table of numbered rows in two groups (rows 1-15 and rows 1-14), with feast-day entries in the wide column to the right. A small "15" sits at the lower right under the table.

main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ. | Christi.

page.notes: The small "15" at the lower right below the table is uncertain: it may be an indiction number for the following page or a page-end figure, and is left out of the main text. Column headers are printed across the top of the table and transcribed as one line in printed order; the column order and cell separators are my reading of the table layout. The feast entries ("2 Febr.", "1 Febr.", "31 Ian.", "30 Ian.", "29 Ian.", "28 Ian.", "27 Ian.") are transcribed as printed, with their leading dash leaders omitted.
